```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The misuse of prescription painkillers – opioids – is a related problem.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Heroin and opioid abuse affects communities, homes, and families in ways that have grave effects on Americans in every community.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Both the sales and overdose deaths from opioids have quadrupled.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The opioid crisis is ravaging communities all over the country, often hitting rural areas harder than urban areas.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republican legislation allows Medicare Part D and Medicare Advantage plans to limit patients to a single pharmacy because over-prescription of drugs is a large part of the problem.",
"claim_types":["policy_position","factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Congressional Republicans have called upon the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services to ensure that no physician will be penalized for limiting opioid prescriptions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for expeditious agreement between the House and Senate on the Comprehensive Addiction and Recovery Act, which addresses the opioid epidemic from both the demand and supply sides of the problem.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Alexander Hamilton wrote in Federalist 23 that the first of the “principal” constitutional obligations of the federal government is to provide for the “common defense” of the United States.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"President George Washington wisely reminded us that “To be prepared for war is one of the most effectual means of preserving peace.”",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
